description: This header file declares functions related to the Network Management (Nm) interface of the Communication Module (ComM) in an AUTOSAR-based software project. The functions handle network start indication, network mode change, bus sleep mode preparation, bus sleep mode, and restart indication, specific to a network channel.

methods.name: ComM_Nm_NetworkStartIndication
methods.description: Handles indication that a network has started on the specified channel.

methods.name: ComM_Nm_NetworkMode
methods.description: Handles changes to the network mode on the specified channel.

methods.name: ComM_Nm_PrepareBusSleepMode
methods.description: Prepares the bus sleep mode for the specified network channel.

methods.name: ComM_Nm_BusSleepMode
methods.description: Places the bus into sleep mode for the specified network channel.

methods.name: ComM_Nm_RestartIndication
methods.description: Indicates that the network is restarting on the specified channel.
